services_deposit_configuration.name: services_deposit_configuration
services_deposit_configuration.value:
(
        ("services"."requires_deposit" = false and "services"."deposit_amount" is null and "services"."deposit_percent" is null)
        or
        ("services"."requires_deposit" = true and num_nonnulls("services"."deposit_amount", "services"."deposit_percent") = 1)
      )
